title: Damage, then heal
prompt: Using the starter's members and helpers, make `damage_then_heal` take 40 damage, then heal 15, and return health. From 100 that leaves 75.
hints: Each helper changes the same variable at the top of the script (a member variable) in turn.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
